0.37.0: Vibe Cognition now refuses to record memories when it cannot tell who you are, instead of silently attributing them to nobody. Ask Claude to set your identity and it will offer the addresses it found.
Subversion users get identity too: cached SVN credentials are read as a suggestion, so a project with no git setup is no longer anonymous.
Recorded under the wrong address? The new vibe-cognition-remap-identity command corrects past attribution, dry-run by default.
0.36.3: Fixed: non-git projects (for example Subversion) now get .cognition/.gitignore, so machine-local files like last-seen.json stop being committed by accident. Upgrading repairs an affected checkout.
New Subversion guidance: SVN cannot union-merge the journal, so concurrent appends conflict. Ask Claude for the 'Team setup (svn)' section for the keep-both-sides rule and ignore setup.
0.36.2: Lifecycle diagnostics now retain client and sidecar supervisor identity details in startup logs for Claude Code and Codex, including when sidecar stderr is discarded.
Logging only: no new shutdown watches or process-exit changes. These diagnostics support investigation; this release does not fix orphaned processes.
0.33.0: You can now store durable per-machine environment facts about yourself (project root, OS, tool choices) so teammates' sessions detect setup divergence -- ask Claude to remember an environment fact.
Facts are self-only to write, open to read, and always disclosed when stored; ask Claude to remove any of them at any time (one call forgets everything).
Your machines are tracked separately (hostname-keyed, capped at 10) -- facts live in small per-person files under .cognition/people/, committed like the journal.
0.31.0: Groundwork for fixing leaked server processes: the server now identifies its real client and logs stale siblings (report-only -- nothing is acted on, exit behavior is unchanged).
get_status now includes a machine-wide stale-server sweep so you can see leaked vibe_cognition processes at a glance.
0.32.0: Vector embeddings (chromadb) now live in the plugin's data dir, not inside your repo -- the .cognition/chromadb folder in your projects is no longer used and is SAFE TO DELETE.
Embeddings rebuild automatically at the new location the first time each project opens (one-time; larger graphs take a few minutes). Your journal and documents stay in the repo as before.
0.29.0: Session-start now checks once a day for a newer released plugin version and shows a one-line reminder if you're behind (disable with VIBE_UPDATE_NUDGE=off).
Nothing is installed automatically -- updating is always your call; the reminder just tells you the exact /plugin update command to run.
0.30.0: After an update, session-start shows a one-time summary of what's new since your last session (disable with VIBE_WHATS_NEW=off).
The summary is curated and short -- full details always live in CHANGELOG.md.
0.36.0: Codex parity: curation ($vibe-curate) and backfill ($vibe-backfill) now run on Codex, the Plan agent is installed as a Codex role, and the daily update check works against the Codex marketplace.
Edge writes now require a curation-session token minted by cognition_begin_curation, so only the curate-orchestrator can link nodes; every accepted edge records its session.
Skills and agents are rendered per harness from one set of sources (skills-src/, agents-src/) -- edit those, run tools/render_harness.py, and CI keeps both renders in step (see PARITY.md).
0.35.0: vibe-cognition now installs into OpenAI Codex CLI as a plugin: codex plugin marketplace add Haagndaazer/colton-claude-plugins, then codex plugin add vibe-cognition@coltondyck; restart Codex once.
On Codex the session-start hook registers the MCP server bound to whatever project you open, injects the project digest, and re-injects the standing practices after /compact.
0.36.1: Docs: how to share your Claude Code skills with Codex without duplicating them -- link .agents/skills to .claude/skills (README, Codex CLI section, and the cognition_readme guide).
